referenceFunction.generalComment: The dataset is identical to RER except for origin of electricity (CN grid). Generic estimation based on literature data. Two reference plants with 100 MW and 500 MW have been considered. The module represents a mix of the two sizes with a share of 10% and 90%, respectively (estimation for RER). ; UUID: 15d5c6c0-1fd5-3995-b773-9127b5528e1e
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The module is identical to RER dataset and includes materials, energy and transport requirements used for construction of the plant. Disposal of material after dismantling is also included.
